meta.title: A locked event refuses any revision after submission
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: the documented correct behaviour is a refusal, but the case checks only that the app does not crash (it records today's behaviour)
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (`lock_quote_after_submission` must be on for this case's outcome to hold) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Revise bid is locked. You cannot edit your quote after submission.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: A locked event refuses any revision after submission

expected.message: Revise bid is locked. You cannot edit your quote after submission.
